readings.title: Duty of the Kohathites
readings.subtitle: The Set-Apart Vessels
readings.text: [Numbers 4:1] And <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> spoke to Mosheh and to Aharon, saying, [2] <dq>“Take a census of the sons of Qehath from among the sons of Lĕwi, by their clans, by their fathers’ houses,</dq> [3] <dq>from thirty years old and above, up to fifty years old, everyone who enters the service to do the work in the Tent of Appointment.</dq> [4] <dq>“This is the service of the sons of Qehath in the Tent of Appointment: the most set-apart possessions.</dq> [5] <dq>“And when the camp moves out, Aharon and his sons shall come, and they shall take down the covering veil and cover the ark of the Witness with it,</dq> [6] <dq>and shall put on it a covering of fine leather, and spread over it a cloth entirely of blue, and shall put in its poles.</dq> [7] <dq>“And over the table of showbread they shall spread a blue cloth, and shall put on it the dishes, and the ladles, and the bowls, and the jars for pouring. And the continual bread shall be on it.</dq> [8] <dq>“And they shall spread over them a scarlet cloth, and cover the same with a covering of fine leather, and shall put in its poles.</dq> [9] <dq>“And they shall take a blue cloth and cover the lampstand of the light, and its lamps, and its snuffers, and its trays, and all its oil vessels, with which they service it.</dq> [10] <dq>“And they shall put it and all its utensils in a covering of fine leather, and put it on a bar.</dq> [11] <dq>“And over the golden altar they shall spread a blue cloth, and cover it with a covering of fine leather, and shall put in its poles.</dq> [12] <dq>“And they shall take all the utensils of service with which they serve in the set-apart place, and shall put them in a blue cloth, and cover them with a covering of fine leather, and put them on a bar.</dq> [13] <dq>“And they shall take away the ashes from the altar, and spread a purple cloth over it,</dq> [14] <dq>and shall put on it all its utensils with which they service it: the fire-pans, the forks, and the shovels, and the basins, all the utensils of the altar. And they shall spread on it a covering of fine leather, and shall put in its poles.</dq> [15] <dq>“And when Aharon and his sons have finished covering the set-apart objects and all the furnishings of the set-apart place, when the camp is about to move, then the sons of Qehath shall come to lift them, so that they do not touch the set-apart objects, lest they die. These are the burdens of the sons of Qehath in the Tent of Appointment.”</dq>

readings.title: Oversight and Warning
readings.subtitle: The Responsibility of Eleazar
readings.text: [Numbers 4:16] <dq>“And the oversight of El‛azar, son of Aharon the priest, is the oil for the light, and the sweet incense, and the continual grain offering, and the anointing oil – the oversight of all the Dwelling Place and all that is in it, in the set-apart place and its furnishings.”</dq> [17] And <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> spoke to Mosheh and to Aharon, saying, [18] <dq>“Do not cut off the tribe of the clans of the Qehathites from among the Lĕwites,</dq> [19] <dq>but do this to them, and they shall live and not die when they approach the most set-apart objects: Aharon and his sons shall go in and appoint each of them to his service and his burden.</dq> [20] <dq>“But they shall not go in to look at the set-apart objects for a moment, lest they die.”</dq>

readings.title: Duty of the Gershonites
readings.subtitle: The Tabernacle Fabrics
readings.text: [Numbers 4:21] And <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> spoke to Mosheh, saying, [22] <dq>“Take a census of the sons of Gĕrshon also, by their fathers’ houses, by their clans.</dq> [23] <dq>“From thirty years old and above, up to fifty years old, you register them, everyone who enters to perform the service, to do the work in the Tent of Appointment.</dq> [24] <dq>“This is the service of the clans of the Gĕrshonites, in serving and in bearing burdens:</dq> [25] <dq>“They shall bear the curtains of the Dwelling Place, and the Tent of Appointment with its covering, and the covering of fine leather that is on top of it, and the screen for the door of the Tent of Appointment,</dq> [26] <dq>“and the screens of the courtyard, and the screen for the door of the gate of the courtyard which is around the Dwelling Place and the altar, and their cords, and all the equipment for their service and all that is made for them. So they shall serve.</dq> [27] <dq>“Aharon and his sons are to command all the service of the sons of the Gĕrshonites, all their burdens and all their service. And you shall appoint to them the responsibility for all their burdens.”</dq> [28] This is the service of the clans of the sons of Gĕrshon in the Tent of Appointment. And their duties are under the authority of Ithamar, son of Aharon the priest.

readings.title: Duty of the Merarites
readings.subtitle: The Tabernacle Structure
readings.text: [Numbers 4:29] <dq>“The sons of Merari, by their clans and by their fathers’ houses, you shall register them.</dq> [30] <dq>“From thirty years old and above, up to fifty years old, you register them, everyone who enters the service to do the work of the Tent of Appointment.</dq> [31] <dq>“And this is the duty of their burden, according to all their service for the Tent of Appointment: the boards of the Dwelling Place, and its bars, and its columns, and its sockets,</dq> [32] <dq>“and the columns of the courtyard all around, with their sockets, and their pegs, and their cords, with all their equipment and for all their service. And you shall assign to each man by name the items of his duty to bear.”</dq> [33] This is the service of the clans of the sons of Merari according to all their service for the Tent of Appointment, under the authority of Ithamar, son of Aharon the priest.

readings.title: Result of the Census
readings.subtitle: Registration of the Service Groups
readings.text: [Numbers 4:34] And Mosheh and Aharon and the leaders of the congregation registered the sons of the Qehathites by their clans and by their fathers’ houses, [35] from thirty years old and above, up to fifty years old, everyone who entered the service for the work in the Tent of Appointment. [36] And those registered by their clans were two thousand seven hundred and fifty. [37] These were those registered of the clans of the Qehathites, all who serve in the Tent of Appointment, whom Mosheh and Aharon registered according to the command of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> by the hand of Mosheh. [38] And those registered of the sons of Gĕrshon, by their clans and by their fathers’ houses, [39] from thirty years old and above, up to fifty years old, everyone who entered the service for the work in the Tent of Appointment, [40] even those registered by their clans, by their fathers’ houses, were two thousand six hundred and thirty. [41] These are those registered of the clans of the sons of Gĕrshon, all who serve in the Tent of Appointment, whom Mosheh and Aharon registered according to the command of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>. [42] And those registered of the clans of the sons of Merari, by their clans, by their fathers’ houses, [43] from thirty years old and above, up to fifty years old, everyone who entered the service for the work in the Tent of Appointment, [44] even those registered by their clans, were three thousand two hundred. [45] These are those registered of the clans of the sons of Merari, whom Mosheh and Aharon registered according to the command of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> by the hand of Mosheh. [46] All those registered of the Lĕwites, whom Mosheh and Aharon and the leaders of Yisra’ĕl registered, by their clans and by their fathers’ houses, [47] from thirty years old and above, up to fifty years old, everyone who came to do the work of service and the work of bearing burdens in the Tent of Appointment, [48] even those registered were eight thousand five hundred and eighty. [49] According to the command of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> by the hand of Mosheh, they were registered, each one according to his service and according to his burden. Thus they were registered by him, as <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> commanded Mosheh.

readings.title: Purity of the Camp
readings.subtitle: Expelling the Unclean
readings.text: [Numbers 5:1] And <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> spoke to Mosheh, saying, [2] <dq>“Command the children of Yisra’ĕl that they put out of the camp every leper, and everyone who has a discharge, and whoever becomes unclean for a being.</dq> [3] <dq>“Put out both male and female, put them outside the camp, so that they do not defile their camps where <dn>I</dn> dwell in their midst.”</dq> [4] And the children of Yisra’ĕl did so, and put them outside the camp. As <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> spoke to Mosheh, so the children of Yisra’ĕl did.

readings.title: Law of Restitution
readings.subtitle: Confession and Compensation
readings.text: [Numbers 5:5] And <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> spoke to Mosheh, saying, [6] <dq>“Speak to the children of Yisra’ĕl, ‘When a man or woman commits any sin that men commit, by trespassing against <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, and that being is guilty,</dq> [7] <dq>then they shall confess their sin which they have done. And he shall return his guilt-offering in its principal, plus one-fifth of it, and give it to whom he has been guilty.</dq> [8] <dq>‘But if the man has no relative to whom the guilt-offering may be returned, the guilt-offering goes to <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, for the priest, besides the ram of the atonement with which atonement is made for him.</dq> [9] <dq>‘And every contribution of all the set-apart objects of the children of Yisra’ĕl, which they bring to the priest, is his.</dq> [10] <dq>‘And every man’s set-apart objects are his; whatever any man gives the priest becomes his.’ ”</dq>

readings.title: The Trial for Jealousy
readings.subtitle: Procedure for Suspected Infidelity
readings.text: [Numbers 5:11] And <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> spoke to Mosheh, saying, [12] <dq>“Speak to the children of Yisra’ĕl, and say to them, ‘If any man’s wife goes astray and has committed a trespass against him,</dq> [13] <dq>and a man has lain with her carnally, and it is hidden from the eyes of her husband, and she has concealed that she has defiled herself, and there was no witness against her, nor was she caught,</dq> [14] <dq>and a spirit of jealousy comes upon him and he becomes jealous of his wife who has defiled herself; or if a spirit of jealousy comes upon him and he becomes jealous of his wife, although she has not defiled herself,</dq> [15] <dq>then the man shall bring his wife to the priest. And he shall bring the offering for her, one-tenth of an ĕphah of barley flour. He is not to pour oil on it or put frankincense on it, because it is a grain offering of jealousy, a grain offering of remembrance, for bringing crookedness to remembrance.</dq> [16] <dq>‘And the priest shall bring her near, and shall make her stand before <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>.</dq> [17] <dq>‘And the priest shall take set-apart water in an earthen vessel, and take some of the dust that is on the floor of the Dwelling Place and put it into the water.</dq> [18] <dq>‘And the priest shall make the woman stand before <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, and shall uncover the woman’s head, and put the grain offering of remembrance in her hands, which is the grain offering of jealousy, while the priest holds in his hand the bitter water that brings a curse.</dq> [19] <dq>‘And the priest shall make her swear, and say to the woman, “If no man has lain with you, and if you have not gone astray into uncleanness under your husband’s authority, be free from this bitter water that brings a curse.</dq> [20] <dq>“But if you have gone astray under your husband’s authority, and if you have defiled yourself and some man other than your husband has lain with you” –</dq> [21] <dq>then the priest shall make the woman swear with the oath of the curse, and the priest shall say to the woman – “<dn>YeHoVaH</dn> make you a curse and an oath among your people, when <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> makes your thigh waste away and your entire body swell,</dq> [22] <dq>and this water that brings a curse shall go into your inward parts, and make your body swell and your thigh waste away.” And the woman shall say, “Amĕn, amĕn.”</dq>

readings.title: The Bitter Water
readings.subtitle: The Verdict of YeHoVaH
readings.text: [Numbers 5:23] <dq>‘And the priest shall write these curses in a book, and shall wipe them off into the bitter water.</dq> [24] <dq>‘And he shall make the woman drink the bitter water that brings a curse, and the water that brings a curse shall enter into her to become bitter.</dq> [25] <dq>‘And the priest shall take the grain offering of jealousy from the woman’s hand, and shall wave the grain offering before <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, and bring it to the altar.</dq> [26] <dq>‘And the priest shall take a handful of the grain offering as its remembrance portion, and burn it on the altar, and afterward make the woman drink the water.</dq> [27] <dq>‘And when he has made her drink the water, then it shall be, if she has defiled herself and has committed a trespass against her husband, that the water that brings a curse shall enter her and become bitter, and her body shall swell, and her thigh shall waste away, and the woman shall become a curse among her people.</dq> [28] <dq>‘But if the woman has not defiled herself, and is clean, then she shall be clear and shall conceive children.</dq> [29] <dq>‘This is the law of jealousy, when a wife, under her husband’s authority, goes astray and defiles herself,</dq> [30] <dq>or when a spirit of jealousy comes upon a man, and he becomes jealous of his wife, then he shall make the woman stand before <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, and the priest shall do to her all this law.</dq> [31] <dq>‘And the man shall be clear from crookedness, but the woman shall bear her crookedness.’ ”</dq>
